description: Distinct from ADV2-047's shape: there, the dynamic require sits inside a called function of the ENTRYPOINT's own file. Before VT-307a, no edge connected the entrypoint's <module> node to vt2-holder's own <module> node, so this blocker was invisible to any entrypoint-rooted traversal even though loading vt2-holder genuinely executes it. A human analyst cannot rule out reachability here: absence from the statically-discovered graph is not, by itself, proof this instance is unreachable. The correct answer is UNKNOWN, never a confident NOT_AFFECTED.

category: 55. VT-307c-fix-8 regression: TypeScript `import x = require(pkg)` invisible to the call graph, hiding a genuinely reachable vulnerable call
description: The entrypoint reaches vt2-holder exclusively via TypeScript's `import holder = require("vt2-holder")` -- a first-class CommonJS module load, not an ordinary `import` declaration and not a `require()` call expression. Before VT-307c-fix-8, this syntax was indexed nowhere in SourceIndex/ModuleModel, so `holder` had no import binding at all and `holder.useHolder()` could only be classified as unsupported_construct -- making the entrypoint's own real, statically-reachable call into the NESTED vt2-vuln-lib@1.0.0 instance (via vt2-holder's own require('vt2-vuln-lib') and useHolder()) invisible, a false UNKNOWN instead of AFFECTED. vt2-holder also keeps ADV2-054's own module._compile(pluginName) top-level construct, so the separate, never-imported top-level vt2-vuln-lib@1.9.0 instance stays correctly UNKNOWN throughout -- this scenario's own regression is entirely about entrypoint-level import-equals reachability, not about widening-construct detection (already covered by ADV2-054).
reason: vt2-holder is loaded via TypeScript's `import x = require(...)` syntax, which is a real, statically-resolvable CommonJS module load exactly like `const x = require(...)` -- and useHolder() genuinely, statically calls the nested vt2-vuln-lib@1.0.0 instance's dangerousOp(). A human analyst reading this file sees an unambiguous, direct static call path with no dynamic construct anywhere on it: this must be AFFECTED, not UNKNOWN and not NOT_AFFECTED, regardless of which import syntax the entrypoint happens to use.
